name: u1-klipper-tmc-autotune
title: TMC Autotune for Snapmaker U1
author: Andrew McGregor and contributors; Snapmaker U1 adaptation contributors
description: Packages Klipper TMC Autotune for the Snapmaker U1 vendor Klipper layout, using the published BJ42D29-Y2V01 profile on the TMC2240 X/Y axes and an editable Y2-winding profile for the BJ42D22-130 motor on the TMC2209 Z axis. Bespok3d renders a printer-specific configuration, preserves the stock sensorless-homing thresholds, and handles placement, restart, rollback, reconfiguration, and removal.
tagline: Motor-aware TMC tuning with U1-safe configuration.

variables.name: U1_Z_RESISTANCE
variables.description: BJ42D22-130 phase resistance in ohms from its exact datasheet or measurement.

variables.name: U1_Z_INDUCTANCE
variables.description: BJ42D22-130 phase inductance in henries from its exact datasheet or measurement.

variables.name: U1_Z_MAX_CURRENT
variables.description: BJ42D22-130 rated phase current in amperes.

config.label: BJ42D22-130 resistance (ohms)
config.hint: Y2-winding default: 4.0 ohms per phase. Override if an exact -130 sheet or measurement differs.

config.label: BJ42D22-130 inductance (henries)
config.hint: Y2-winding default: 7.9 mH, expressed here as 0.0079 H.

config.label: BJ42D22-130 holding torque (Nm)
config.hint: Y2-winding default: 400 mNm, expressed here as 0.40 Nm.

config.label: BJ42D22-130 rated current (A)
config.hint: Y2-winding default: 1.0 A; the stock 0.85 A RMS run_current is 85% of this rating.

attributions: Klipper TMC Autotune is copyright Andrew McGregor and contributors and is licensed under GPL-3.0. This package is based on upstream commit b6c7cfa98c2ef880812d5279a9117cbe67d6d4d5. The Snapmaker U1 adaptation adds Bespok3d packaging, a variable-rendered U1 configuration, compatibility tests, and documentation; it does not alter the upstream tuning algorithm. Complete corresponding source is available in the public fork.
